title: Page 2
content_zh:
在丫鬟的带领下，主仆二人往偏厅方向而去，一踏入偏厅，即见到苏家三人已落坐了。

「苏伯父、珠姨、苏大哥早。」裴璎珞有礼地朝三人弯身一福。

「璎珞，快别客气了。」苏夫人笑呵呵地亲自上前将她扶起，拉着她的手让她坐在儿子身旁的空位，愈看两人，愈是满意。

「璎珞，昨晚睡得可好？」苏老爷见到故友之女，十分开心。

「多谢苏伯父关心，璎珞睡得很好。」裴璎珞朝两位长辈浅笑回应。

「璎珞，昨儿个实在是太忙了，一直没有机会好好和你说上话，珠姨可是十分高兴你能来这一趟。你们三姊妹都是难得一见的美人，个个都像你娘一样貌美，也难怪你大哥老爱用你们三姊妹当珠玉阁的活招牌，可真有生意头脑。」

苏夫人满意地打量她一身灵秀温婉出众的气质。裴家三姊妹自小就具有沉鱼落雁之姿，可不知为何，她就是独对裴璎珞特别疼爱，一心只想要她当自个儿的媳妇。

「娘，别净说话，璎珞该是饿了。」苏坤源斯文的脸上含笑，替她夹了些菜到碗里。

这一幕，看得两老心底更是欢喜。

「多谢苏大哥。」裴璎珞朝他一笑。

「璎珞，三个月前，在你大姊琉璃的喜宴上匆匆见你一面，没想到这么快我们又见面了。难得来一趟，就多住些日子再回去吧。」苏夫人热情邀约。

还记得喜宴上裴璎珞和裴珊瑚的出现艳惊四座，令人印象深刻；但大家心照不宣，无人敢打裴珊瑚的主意，除非是存心冒着得罪二皇子的危险。因此众人纷纷向裴老爷和裴夫人提亲，一场喜宴差点变成裴璎珞的提亲大会。

她可是仗着自己和裴家的私交，才得以要求在自家老爷寿宴时，一定要让裴璎珞亲自来一趟，看是否能凑成一对佳偶。

「好的，那璎珞就暂时住下叨扰了。」裴璎珞这趟前来除了贺寿之外，另有两件事要办，刚好趁此机会答应了下来。

一顿早膳在宾主尽欢下结束，苏坤源更是在爹娘明显的授意下，陪着裴璎珞逛自家大宅。两人并肩走在花木扶疏的花园小径，阵阵凉风吹来，飘散着一股花香。

「璎珞，谢谢你愿意前来帮我。」苏坤源眼见四下无人，仅有秋月随侍，遂放心开口。

「谁叫悦儿是我的好姐妹，你们两个一起写信求我，我纵使再不愿，也得来一趟。」裴璎珞温柔一笑。

苏坤源深深地看她一眼。若非他早已心有所属，绝对会被身旁灵秀温婉的人儿所吸引。因为裴璎珞不只拥有闭月羞花之貌，性情又温婉和善，这样一个表里如一、人见人爱的佳人，错过的确是可惜了。

「多谢了。只不过接下来可能要委屈你了。」苏坤源歉疚地说。毕竟利用了她，他心底并不好过。

「只要你不亏待悦儿，我就不觉委屈了。」

她此次前来，全是因好友上官悦写信拜托她来一趟。明明是情投意合的两人，却因上官悦是妾室所生，在上官家一向不受宠，因而苏老爷和夫人不同意两人来往。加上苏、裴两家相识多年，苏夫人又属意她，因此两人的婚事更是难上加难，上官悦只好求助她帮忙。

「我此生绝不负悦儿，只不过爹娘十分喜欢你，才得请你配合演一场戏。」他现在连要见上官悦一面都不被允准，有了裴璎珞帮忙，相信两人很快就可以再见面了。

「苏大哥，我也好久没有见着悦儿了，不如我们这就约她出来相见如何？」两人一同出门，苏伯父和珠姨绝对不会怀疑的。

「好。多谢了。」苏坤源一脸欣喜，他已有几天没见到悦儿，自是十分想念。

「那我们走吧。」裴璎珞笑看他脸上难掩的喜悦，两人一同往大门走去。

跟随在两人身后的秋月忍不住仰首翻了个白眼。二小姐这次来根本是为他人作嫁。想到自家夫人在知道二小姐愿意前来时那开心的模样，现在看来根本是空欢喜一场。

第1章(2)

春日客栈

苏家的马车缓缓停在客栈门前，在苏坤源扶着裴璎珞下马车后，一眼瞧见从客栈里走出一名身着月牙白袍、身形挺拔的身形后，双眼发亮，一脸惊喜地忙不迭走上前去。

「慕容兄。」

慕容彻闻声回头瞥去，清俊的脸上含笑，立即认出他来。

「原来是苏兄。」黑眸在瞧见他身后的裴璎珞时，那笑容显得意味深长。

裴璎珞没想到会再次见到这个在谈笑间轻易动杀念的男人，更没想到他与苏大哥是相识的，只能说这也未免太巧了吧。

「慕容兄，没想到会在这遇见你，你是来巡视灵凤轩的吗？」

苏坤源和慕容彻有几面之缘，交情并不深，只知此人是灵山岛慕容家的少主，手中有几间灵凤轩，专做水晶买卖。灵凤轩所售的水晶价格更胜珠玉阁，绝非常人买得起；而其水晶的品质更堪称全国之冠，只因灵山岛有丰富的矿脉，开采出来的水晶皆属上品。

「没错。这位是？」慕容彻笑望他身后的佳人。

「璎珞，这位是灵山岛的慕容少主。慕容兄，这位是珠玉阁的裴家二小姐，算起来你们两家所经营的生意倒有些类似。」苏坤源为二人相互介绍。

「原来是裴二小姐。」慕容彻清俊脸上的笑别具深意。

「璎珞见过慕容少主。」裴璎珞杏眸微敛，目光未瞧向他，虽然对此人所作所为不认同，但仍依礼弯身一福，然后便朝苏坤源提醒：「苏大哥，我们该进去了。」

「慕容兄，我还有要事，就先告辞了，他日若有机会再与慕容兄喝上一杯。」

苏坤源朝他拱手拜别，便和裴璎珞一同走进客栈里。

慕容彻瞧着两人离去的背影，自是察觉到裴璎珞目光回避着他，唇角的笑多了抹兴味。

踏进客栈的两人正欲开口询问柜台后的掌柜，掌柜在这时抬头，瞥了两人一眼，快一步地出声询问：

「两位客倌可是苏公子和裴姑娘？」

「正是。」两人互视一眼，异口同声回答。

「有位上官姑娘早已在二楼包厢等候，两位请随我来。」掌柜忍不住多瞧了裴璎珞一眼，暗忖玄武城何时来了一位倾城佳人。

两人面露欣喜，尾随掌柜身后，拾级而上，来到二楼最末间包厢前停下。

「两位，就是这间了。」掌柜将人带到后，便先行离开。

「二小姐。」

包厢门在此时由内推开，秋月开心的笑脸出现在两人面前。她是在听到掌柜的声音时，便料到两人来了。

「秋月，辛苦你了。」裴璎珞朝她一笑，她先前已让秋月去一趟上官府通知上官悦来这春日客栈见面。

「璎珞。」上官悦来到秋月身后，在瞧见好友后，忍不住高兴得双眸泛红，好友真的为了帮她而来。

「悦儿。」

裴璎珞开心地走上前，两人高兴地相拥，半晌后，便开始打量着对方。

「璎珞，我们两年不见，你愈来愈美了，美得出尘，令人目眩神迷。」上官悦话里无一丝妒意，只有对好友的诚心赞美。

「你不也出落得娇俏动人，才会令某人一日不见如隔三秋。」裴璎珞一句话同时取笑了两人。

上官悦闻言，羞涩地瞥了眼一旁的心上人，在见到他温柔的目光后，更是双颊绯红。

「坐吧！别都站着。」苏坤源招呼着两人落坐，桌上已备妥三人爱吃的茶点。
content_en:
Under the leadership of the maid, the master and servant headed towards the side hall. As soon as they stepped into the side hall, they saw the three members of the Su family already seated.

"Good morning, Uncle Su, Aunt Zhu, Brother Su." Pei Yingluo bowed towards the three of them politely.

"Yingluo, please stop being polite." Mrs. Su smiled and stepped forward to help her up, holding her hand and letting her sit in the empty seat next to her son. The more she looked at the two of them, the more satisfied she became.

"Yingluo, how did you sleep last night?" Mr. Su was very happy to see the daughter of his old friend.

"Thank you, Uncle Su, for your concern. Yingluo slept well." Pei Yingluo responded with a smile towards the two elders.

"Yingluo, I was really busy yesterday and never had the chance to talk to you. Aunt Zhu is very happy that you can come this time. You three sisters are all rare beauties. You are all as beautiful as your mother. It's no wonder that your eldest brother always likes to use you three sisters as the living signs of Zhuyu Pavilion. You are really business-minded."

Mrs. Su looked at her elegant, gentle and outstanding temperament with satisfaction.The three sisters of the Pei family have been like fish and wild geese since they were young, but for some unknown reason, they are particularly fond of Pei Yingluo and only want her to be their daughter-in-law.

"Mom, please stop talking, Yingluo must be hungry." Su Kunyuan put a smile on his gentle face and put some vegetables into the bowl for her.

This scene made the two elders even more happy in their hearts.

"Thank you, Brother Su." Pei Yingluo smiled at him.

"Yingluo, three months ago, I briefly met you at your eldest sister Liuli's wedding banquet. I didn't expect that we would meet again so soon. It's a rare trip, so please stay for a while before going back." Mrs. Su warmly invited.

I still remember that the appearance of Pei Yingluo and Pei Coral at the wedding banquet shocked everyone and was impressive. However, everyone tacitly understood that no one dared to challenge Pei Coral unless they deliberately risked offending the second prince.Therefore, everyone proposed to Mr. Pei and Mrs. Pei one after another, and the wedding banquet almost turned into a marriage proposal meeting for Pei Yingluo.

Relying on her personal relationship with the Pei family, she was able to request that Pei Yingluo come in person during her father's birthday party to see if they could make a good couple.

"Okay, then Yingluo will stay with you for the time being." Pei Yingluo had two other things to do during this trip besides congratulating her on her birthday, so she just took this opportunity to agree.

The breakfast meal ended with the guests and hosts enjoying themselves, and Su Kunyuan accompanied Pei Yingluo to visit his mansion under the obvious instructions of his parents.The two of them walked side by side along the garden path with scattered flowers and trees, and the cool breeze blew, spreading the fragrance of flowers.

"Yingluo, thank you for coming to help me." Seeing that there was no one around except Qiu Yue, Su Kunyuan said with relief.

"Yue'er is my good sister. You two write to me together to beg me. Even if I don't want to, I still have to come." Pei Yingluo smiled softly.

Su Kunyuan looked at her deeply.If he hadn't already fallen in love with someone, he would definitely be attracted by the smart and gentle people around him.Because Pei Yingluo not only has a beautiful appearance, but also has a gentle and kind temperament. It would be a pity to miss such a beautiful woman who is the same on the outside and loved by everyone.

"Thank you very much. But I may have to wrong you next time." Su Kunyuan said apologetically.After all, he didn't feel good about taking advantage of her.

"As long as you don't treat Yue'er badly, I won't feel aggrieved."

She came here this time because her friend Shangguan Yue wrote a letter asking her to come.They were obviously in love with each other, but because Shangguan Yue was born from a concubine and was never favored in the Shangguan family, Mr. Su and his wife did not agree with their interaction.In addition, the Su and Pei families had known each other for many years, and Mrs. Su was interested in her, so their marriage was even more difficult, so Shangguan Yue had to ask her for help.

"I will never let Yue'er down in this life. It's just that my parents like you very much, so they have to ask you to cooperate in a play." Now he is not even allowed to see Shangguan Yue. With Pei Yingluo's help, I believe the two will be able to meet again soon.

"Brother Su, I haven't seen Yue'er for a long time. How about we invite her out to meet her now?" When they go out together, Uncle Su and Aunt Zhu will never suspect anything.

"Okay. Thank you." Su Kunyuan looked happy. He hadn't seen Yue'er for a few days and he missed her very much.

"Then let's go." Pei Yingluo smiled at the unconcealable joy on his face, and the two of them walked towards the door together.

Qiuyue, who was following the two of them, couldn't help but raise her head and roll her eyes.The second young lady came here to marry someone else.Thinking of how happy my wife was when she found out that the second young lady was willing to come, now it seems that her joy was all in vain.

Chapter 1(2)

Spring Inn

The Su family's carriage slowly stopped in front of the inn. After Su Kunyuan helped Pei Yingluo get out of the carriage, he saw a tall and tall figure in a crescent white robe walking out of the inn. His eyes were bright and he hurriedly stepped forward with a look of surprise on his face.

"Brother Murong."

Murong Che heard the sound and glanced back. With a smile on his handsome face, he immediately recognized him.

"It turns out to be Brother Su." When his black eyes saw Pei Yingluo behind him, his smile seemed meaningful.

Pei Yingluo didn't expect to see this man who easily turned to murderous thoughts while talking and laughing again, and she didn't expect that he and Brother Su were acquaintances. She could only say that it was a coincidence.

"Brother Murong, I didn't expect to see you here. Are you here to inspect Lingfengxuan?"

Su Kunyuan and Murong Che had met several times, but their friendship was not deep. They only knew that this man was the young master of the Murong family on Lingshan Island. He owned several Lingfeng Pavilions and specialized in crystal business.The price of the crystals sold in Lingfengxuan is even higher than that of Zhuyu Pavilion, making it affordable for ordinary people. The quality of its crystals is also the best in the country, because Lingshan Island has rich mineral veins, and the crystals mined are all of the highest quality.

"That's right. Who is this?" Murong Che looked at the beauty behind him with a smile.

"Yingluo, this is Young Master Murong from Lingshan Island. Brother Murong, this is the second lady of the Pei family from Zhuyu Pavilion. It seems that the businesses you two run are somewhat similar." Su Kunyuan introduced the two of them to each other.

"It turns out to be Miss Pei Er." The smile on Murong Che's handsome face was profound.

"Yingluo has met Young Master Murong." Pei Yingluo narrowed her almond-shaped eyes and did not look at him. Although she did not agree with what this person did, she still bowed in obedience and reminded Su Kunyuan: "Brother Su, we should go in."

"Brother Murong, I have something else to do, so I'll take my leave now. If I have a chance, I'll have a drink with Brother Murong someday."

Su Kunyuan waved goodbye to him and walked into the inn with Pei Yingluo.

Murong Che watched the two people leaving and noticed that Pei Yingluo was avoiding him, and the smile on her lips became more interesting.

The two people who stepped into the inn were about to ask the shopkeeper behind the counter. At this moment, the shopkeeper raised his head, glanced at the two people, and asked quickly:

"Are these two waiters Mr. Su and Miss Pei?"

"Exactly." The two looked at each other and replied in unison.

"There is a Shangguan girl waiting in the box on the second floor. Please follow me." The shopkeeper couldn't help but glance at Pei Yingluo, secretly wondering when a beautiful lady came to Xuanwu City.

With expressions of joy on their faces, the two followed the shopkeeper up the stairs and stopped in front of the last box on the second floor.

"You two, this is the room." After the shopkeeper brought the people there, he left first.

"Second Miss."

At this time, the box door was pushed open from the inside, and Qiuyue's happy smiling face appeared in front of the two of them.She expected the two men to come when she heard the shopkeeper's voice.

"Qiuyue, thank you for your hard work." Pei Yingluo smiled at her. She had previously asked Qiuyue to go to Shangguan Mansion to inform Shangguan Yue to meet at the Spring Inn.

"Yingluo." Shangguan Yue came behind Qiu Yue. After seeing her friend, she couldn't help but her eyes turned red with joy. Her friend really came to help her.

"Yue'er."

Pei Yingluo walked forward happily, and the two hugged each other happily. After a while, they began to look at each other.

"Yingluo, we haven't seen each other for two years, and you are becoming more and more beautiful. You are so beautiful that you are dazzling." There was no trace of jealousy in Shangguan Yue's words, only sincere praise for his friend.

"Aren't you also so charming and charming that you can make someone feel like they've been missing each other for a day?" Pei Yingluo teased the two of them at the same time.

Upon hearing this, Shangguan Yue glanced shyly at her sweetheart beside her, and her cheeks turned red after seeing his gentle gaze.

"Sit down! Don't just stand around." Su Kunyuan greeted the two of them to sit down. Their favorite refreshments were already prepared on the table.
